verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents business verification levels with dedicated Company data, Company documents and Associated parties steps, so a KYB flow covering related parties exists. Its AML screening also extends to third parties, not just individual applicants. However, the evidence only comes from a migration note, and registry lookups, explicit UBO identification and the chaining of owners into their own KYC are not described. Missing for 10: company registry lookup evidence, explicit UBO identification and ownership-structure docs, documented chaining of associated parties into individual KYC, independent or hands-on corroboration.
